step1.title: What should {{name}} take care of?
step1.subtitle: Choose a service from your cleaner. You can adjust the duration — it affects the price directly.

step2.title: Choose date and time
step2.subtitle: You book directly into the cleaner's calendar. Grey slots are already taken.

step3.title: Final details
step3.subtitle: We send the details directly to {{name}}. The amount is only charged once the provider has accepted your booking request.

address.validated: Address validated — the cleaner can find the place
address.hint: Start typing and choose your address from the list. We check that it's real.
address.loginPromptTail: and save your addresses with access info so the cleaner gets everything automatically.
address.saveAddressPromptTail: in your address book with pets, parking and access info — auto-filled next time.

verify.title: Address confirmation
verify.profileHint: We use the address from your profile. Save it in your address book to add access info and pets.
verify.oneTimeHint: You're using a manual address. Write access info and pets directly in the message to the cleaner below.

notes.label: Notes for the provider (optional)
notes.placeholder: E.g. pets, allergies or how you arrange access with the provider…

payment.label: Payment card
payment.disclaimer: The amount may be held on your card while the booking request is processed. It's only charged once the provider has accepted the booking.

paymentHandling.title: How your payment is handled
paymentHandling.body: {{amount}} may be held on your card. The amount is only paid out to the provider once the service is completed and the booking is closed.

editDialog.title: Edit access & pets
editDialog.description: Changes are saved on "{{label}}" in your address book. You arrange access directly with the provider yourself — MyCleaner does not receive or store keys.
editDialog.instructionsPlaceholder: E.g. key box by the mailbox, ring the buzzer on floor 3…
editDialog.parkingPlaceholder: E.g. free on the street, parking permit required

selectAddress.title: Choose your address
selectAddress.description: Choose a valid address from the list so the provider knows where the job is.

loginRequired.title: Log in to send your booking request
loginRequired.description: Log in so the provider can contact you about the booking.

paymentNotReady.title: Payment isn't ready yet
paymentNotReady.description: The payment field is still loading. Wait a moment and try again.

enterCard.title: Enter your card details
enterCard.description: We use the card to hold the amount — you're only charged once the booking has been accepted.

toast.priceError: We couldn't calculate the price right now. Please try again shortly.
toast.paymentStartError: We couldn't start the payment. Try again, or use a different payment method.
toast.confirmError: The payment couldn't go through. Check your card details, or try a different payment method.

bookingSent.title: Booking sent ✓
bookingSent.description: {{name}} has 24 hours to confirm. The amount is only charged then.

paymentFailed.title: The payment couldn't go through
paymentFailed.description: Check your card details, or try a different payment method.

changesSaved.title: Changes saved
changesSaved.description: Access and pet info has been updated on the address.

step4.title: Your booking request has been sent
step4.description: {{name}} has received your booking request and typically responds within {{responseTime}}. You'll be notified as soon as the request is accepted.

summary.providerNet: Provider's price after platform fee: {{amount}}. MyCleaner is a platform connecting customers and independent providers, handling booking and payment. The service is performed by your chosen provider.
